actions.action: Check brown bumps on stems above water for scale (flick test, sticky leaves)
Rinse roots under lukewarm water and rub off black crust
Snip mushy/slimy/hollow roots with clean scissors
Cut back soft black stem to firm green tissue
Scrub the bottle and refill with fresh water
Replace all the water every 1-2 weeks (tap water left out overnight)
Add liquid houseplant or hydroponic fertilizer at 1/4 strength every 2-4 weeks
Move plant within 1-2 m of a window
Alternatively, put it under a desk lamp 8-12 hours a day
If roots keep blackening, pot it in soil

reason: The answer's main diagnosis is stagnant, topped-off, oxygen- and nutrient-depleted water causing root decay, which matches the confirmed problem. Its fix (clean and trim the roots, do full water changes instead of topping off, add 1/4-strength fertilizer) mirrors what worked, and nothing it recommends is harmful.
